cv.name: Filipe Bravo
cv.title: Software Engineer
cv.about: Computer Engineering graduate with experience building web and mobile applications, REST APIs and internal tools. I work mainly with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript and SQL Server, across the full stack from frontend to API and database. Looking for a software engineering team where I can contribute to quality products and keep growing technically.

bullets: Built an internal leads and proposals reporting tool with ASP.NET Core Razor Pages and SQL Server, with filters and Excel export.
Implemented lead identification by email or domain, with LLM integration to complete company data.
Delivered client websites for brands across different industries in WordPress, building custom pages and components with Elementor.
Implemented responsive layouts and content-driven UI updates.
Completed TakeFreeTours' scheduled email scraper (C#, Gmail API, SQL Server), turning booking confirmations from several platforms into validated, deduplicated visitor records.
Built web and mobile features and REST APIs for client projects, on flexible hours alongside my degree.
Built the frontend and REST API for TakeFreeTours' tour management system (Angular, .NET).
Built the frontend and API for Benched, a multi-platform football app in .NET MAUI with a Blazor UI (C#).
Integrated PayPal payments into a law firm's website (Angular, .NET), now in production.
Worked with Tailwind CSS, Angular Material, Syncfusion and Azure DevOps (project management, CI/CD).
Customized ERP workflows and features in PHC Web and improved a logistics app built with Kalipso Studio.
Fixed bugs, shipped feature updates and provided application support.
